AI Overview
A spacebar counter is an online tool that counts how many times you press the spacebar key on your keyboard. 
How It Works
Modes: You can run the test with no time limit ("No Time" / continuous counting) or select a timed challenge (such as 1, 5, 10, 30, or 60 seconds). 
Timer Trigger: The timer usually does not start until your very first press of the spacebar. 
Metrics Tracked: The tool displays your total spacebar hits and your average presses per second (or clicks per second). 
Key Rules: Holding the spacebar down does not trigger continuous counts; the tool only registers distinct physical presses.
